story_description: Users launching Blaze for the first time need guided onboarding that detects installed AI CLIs, offers one-click installation for missing ones, and configures the environment automatically so they can start coding immediately.
task_description: Implement the CLI detection screen that scans the system for installed AI CLIs (Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex CLI, Aider, OpenCode, Amp), displays their status with version info, and provides one-click installation for missing CLIs via Homebrew, npm, or pip.
atom: CLI Detection Screen with Installation Flow
atom_description: A SwiftUI view that presents a list of supported AI CLIs with their installation status, version numbers when installed, recommended badges, and one-click install buttons that orchestrate dependency checking, package installation, PATH configuration, and verification.
problem_statement: Users may not have all AI CLIs installed when they first launch Blaze, and manually installing command-line tools requires terminal knowledge, dependency management, and PATH configuration. This creates friction in the onboarding experience and may prevent users from using all supported engines.
scope_in: Detect installed CLIs by executing 'which' and version commands for each supported CLI
Display CLI cards showing name, icon, installed/not-installed status, and version when available
Show 'Recommended' badges for Claude Code and Aider based on capabilities
Provide 'Install' button for each missing CLI that triggers installation flow
Implement 'Install All Missing' bulk action button
Check runtime dependencies (Node.js, Python, Rust) before CLI installation
Install missing dependencies via Homebrew automatically
Execute appropriate package manager command (npm, pip, brew) per CLI
Update PATH in shell config file (.zshrc) after installation
Verify installation succeeded by re-running detection
Handle skip action to proceed without installing missing CLIs
scope_out: Authentication or login flows for any CLI - deferred to later screens
CLI configuration beyond PATH setup - handled in subsequent onboarding steps
Updating already-installed CLIs to newer versions - deferred to settings
Custom CLI path configuration - advanced users can configure manually
Windows or Linux support - macOS only for MVP
assumptions: Homebrew is installed or user will install it when prompted
Users have internet connectivity for package downloads
Shell is zsh with config in ~/.zshrc (macOS default since Catalina)
Supported CLIs publish version flags that return clean version strings
npm, pip, and brew commands are available after dependency installation
constraints: Must not require sudo password for standard installations
Must timeout detection commands within 5 seconds to avoid UI freezing
Must not modify PATH if CLI is already accessible
Must show progress feedback during installation (not just spinner)
Must support cancellation of in-progress installations
Installation must be atomic - partial installs should be cleaned up on failure
functional_requirements: FR1: On view appear, execute parallel detection for all six supported CLIs using Process spawn with 5-second timeout
FR2: Display each CLI as a card with icon, name, status badge (Installed/Not Installed), version string when installed, and Recommended badge where applicable
FR3: Show Install button for each not-installed CLI that transitions to installing state with progress indicator
FR4: Install button tap triggers dependency check, then runs appropriate install command, then verifies installation
FR5: Provide Install All Missing button that queues all missing CLI installations in sequence with aggregate progress
FR6: Skip button navigates to next onboarding screen without blocking on missing CLIs
FR7: Next button navigates forward and is enabled only when at least one CLI is installed
FR8: Re-detect CLI status after each successful installation and update UI accordingly
FR9: Display error state with retry option if installation fails, including error message from stderr
nonfunctional_requirements: NFR1: Detection phase completes within 3 seconds for all CLIs running in parallel
NFR2: UI remains responsive during detection and installation with no main thread blocking
NFR3: Installation progress updates at least every 500ms for user feedback
NFR4: Memory footprint for Process spawns stays under 50MB
NFR5: Support VoiceOver accessibility with proper labels for all interactive elements
implementation_steps: Step 1: Create CLIDetectionOnboardingView.swift with @StateObject for CLIDetectionViewModel
Step 2: Define SupportedCLI enum with cases for claudeCode, geminiCLI, codexCLI, aider, openCode, amp including detection commands and install commands
Step 3: Create CLIDetectionResult model with properties: cli enum, isInstalled bool, version optional string, error optional string
Step 4: Implement CLIDetectionViewModel with Published array of detection results and detection/installation methods
Step 5: Create detectCLI async method that spawns Process with which command followed by version command, with 5-second timeout
Step 6: Implement detectAllCLIs using TaskGroup for parallel detection of all supported CLIs
Step 7: Create installCLI async method that checks dependencies, installs if missing, then installs target CLI
Step 8: Implement checkDependencies method that verifies node/python/rust based on CLI requirements
Step 9: Create installDependency method using brew install with progress parsing from stdout
Step 10: Implement runInstallCommand for each CLI type (npm install -g, pip install, brew install)
Step 11: Create updatePathIfNeeded method that appends to ~/.zshrc if path not already present
Step 12: Implement verifyInstallation by re-running detection and comparing results
Step 13: Build CLICardView subview with icon, name, status badge, version, recommended badge, and install button
Step 14: Create InstallProgressView showing current step, progress bar, and cancel button
Step 15: Implement error state UI with error message display and retry button
Step 16: Add Install All Missing button with aggregate progress tracking
Step 17: Wire up Skip and Next navigation buttons with proper enabled states
Step 18: Add telemetry calls for detection results, install attempts, and outcomes
Step 19: Write unit tests for detection logic with mock Process outputs
Step 20: Write UI tests for card interactions and navigation flow
data_model_changes: Add SupportedCLI enum with rawValue strings: claudeCode, geminiCLI, codexCLI, aider, openCode, amp
Add CLIDetectionResult struct with fields: cli (SupportedCLI), isInstalled (Bool), version (String?), error (String?), isRecommended (Bool)
Add CLIInstallState enum: idle, checkingDependencies, installingDependency(String), installingCLI, configuringPath, verifying, completed, failed(Error)
Add DetectionState enum: notStarted, detecting, completed, error(String)
api_contracts: CLIInstaller.install(cli: SupportedCLI, progressHandler: (CLIInstallState) -> Void) async throws -> Void
CLIInstaller.installAll(clis: [SupportedCLI], progressHandler: (SupportedCLI, CLIInstallState) -> Void) async throws -> Void
ShellExecutor.run(command: String, arguments: [String], timeout: TimeInterval) async throws -> (stdout: String, stderr: String, exitCode: Int32)
event_contracts: OnboardingEvent.cliDetectionStarted - emitted when detection phase begins
OnboardingEvent.cliInstallStarted(cli: SupportedCLI) - emitted when install begins for a CLI
OnboardingEvent.cliInstallProgress(cli: SupportedCLI, state: CLIInstallState) - emitted on state changes during install
OnboardingEvent.cliInstallCompleted(cli: SupportedCLI, success: Bool, error: String?) - emitted when install finishes
OnboardingEvent.cliDetectionScreenSkipped - emitted when user clicks Skip
OnboardingEvent.cliDetectionScreenCompleted(installedCLIs: [SupportedCLI]) - emitted when user proceeds with Next
ui_states: Loading state: Spinner with 'Scanning for AI CLIs' text while detection runs
Results state: List of CLI cards showing detection outcomes
Installing state: Progress view overlay showing current installation step and progress bar
Error state: Card shows red status with error message and Retry button
Completed state: All cards show final status with Next button enabled
ui_interactions: Tap Install button on CLI card to trigger single CLI installation flow
Tap Retry button on failed installation to re-attempt installation
Tap Cancel button during installation to abort current install with cleanup
Tap Install All Missing button to queue bulk installation of all missing CLIs
Tap Skip button to proceed to next screen without installing anything
Tap Next button to proceed after at least one CLI is confirmed installed
Pull to refresh triggers re-detection of all CLIs
ui_copy: At least one CLI must be installed to continue
edge_cases: User has CLI installed but not in PATH - detect via common install locations as fallback
CLI command exists but returns non-zero exit code on version check - treat as corrupt installation
Homebrew not installed - prompt user to install Homebrew first with one-click install option
Network timeout during package download - show error with retry option
Disk full during installation - detect error and show actionable message
Another process has lock on package manager - wait with timeout then error
CLI version command returns multi-line output - parse first line only
User .zshrc has syntax errors - append PATH without breaking existing config
failure_modes: Process spawn fails due to sandbox restrictions - show error explaining need for Full Disk Access permission
Installation completes but verification fails - show partial success state with manual instructions
User cancels during dependency install - clean up partial dependency installation
npm/pip not available after node/python install - source shell config before continuing
Multiple simultaneous install attempts - queue installations to run sequentially
Memory pressure during bulk install - pause and retry after GC
rollback_plan: If installation fails mid-process, remove any partially installed packages using brew uninstall, npm uninstall -g, or pip uninstall. Restore original PATH entries in .zshrc by removing only the lines added by Blaze (marked with comment). Track all modifications in OnboardingState for reliable cleanup.

acceptance_tests: Given a fresh macOS system with no CLIs installed, when the detection screen loads, then all six CLIs show Not Installed status
Given Claude Code is installed at /usr/local/bin/claude, when detection runs, then Claude Code card shows Installed with correct version
Given user taps Install on Aider card, when installation completes, then Aider card shows Installed status
Given user taps Install All Missing, when three CLIs are missing, then all three are installed sequentially with progress shown
Given user taps Skip, then navigation proceeds to next screen regardless of CLI status
Given no CLIs are installed, when user taps Next, then button is disabled with tooltip explaining requirement
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Detection runs automatically on view appear and completes within 3 seconds
AC2: All six supported CLIs are checked and results displayed in card format
AC3: Installed CLIs show green checkmark, version number, and no Install button
AC4: Not installed CLIs show red X and enabled Install button
AC5: Claude Code and Aider cards display Recommended badge
AC6: Installing any missing CLI updates card to Installed state upon success
AC7: Installation errors display error message with Retry button
AC8: Skip button always navigates forward regardless of detection results
AC9: Next button only enabled when at least one CLI is detected as installed

criteria: All functional requirements FR1-FR9 implemented and verified
All acceptance criteria AC1-AC9 pass manual verification
Unit test coverage above 80% for CLIDetector and CLIInstaller
UI tests pass for all defined ui_interactions
No memory leaks detected during install flow with Instruments
VoiceOver audit passes with no critical issues
Code reviewed and approved by at least one reviewer

completed_when: The CLI detection screen loads, detects all installed CLIs within 3 seconds, displays their status correctly, allows one-click installation of missing CLIs, and navigates to the next onboarding screen when at least one CLI is confirmed installed.
completed_evidence: Screen recording showing detection of pre-installed Claude Code, one-click installation of Aider from Not Installed to Installed, and successful navigation via Next button. Test report showing all unit and UI tests passing.
status_reason: Specified and ready for implementation. No blocking dependencies. Medium risk due to external process spawning and package manager interactions.
open_questions: Should we support custom CLI paths for users who install in non-standard locations
What fallback should be shown if Homebrew is not installed - auto-install or manual instructions
Should bulk install be parallel or sequential to avoid overwhelming system resources
notes: This is a high-visibility onboarding screen that sets first impressions. Installation reliability is critical - better to show clear errors than fail silently. Consider adding telemetry to track which CLIs users commonly have installed to inform defaults.

na_justifications.dependency_ids: No atoms are required before this screen can be implemented. ShellExecutor and OnboardingCoordinator are existing utilities that can be created as part of this work or stubbed.

verification_steps: Run swift build to verify CLIDetectionOnboardingView.swift compiles without errors
Run swift test --filter CLIDetection to verify all unit tests pass
Launch app in Xcode, navigate to onboarding, verify detection screen appears and shows CLI cards
Install a CLI via the Install button and verify card updates to Installed state
Verify Skip and Next buttons navigate correctly based on installed CLI state

risks: Process spawning may be blocked by macOS sandbox in certain distribution modes
Package manager commands may fail due to network issues or rate limiting
PATH modifications may conflict with user custom shell configurations
Installation may leave system in inconsistent state if cancelled mid-process
mitigations: Document Full Disk Access requirement and detect sandbox issues early with clear user messaging
Implement retry logic with exponential backoff for network failures
Use append-only PATH modifications with clear comment markers for safe removal
Track all modifications in state and implement proper cleanup on cancellation or failure
risk_register.blast_radius: Affects only Onboarding module and new CLI utility files. Does not touch existing session or engine code. User system changes are limited to package installations and PATH additions which are reversible.
risk_register.fallback_plan: If installation features prove unreliable, degrade to detection-only mode showing manual installation instructions for each CLI. Skip button ensures users can always proceed past this screen.
